title: Cleft Sentences
rule: Cleft sentences emphasize one part of a sentence.

examples.text: It is today that we must decide.
It was in Paris that they met.
It is honesty that matters most.
It was because of rain that we canceled.

practicePrompt: Complete: It was Maria ___ solved the problem.
